_dates_match() uses 31-day tolerance for month-level precision matching
_compute_compliance_status() correctly blocks mismatch/expired/missing_expiration from satisfying compliance
Background verification (_run_expiration_verification) triggered on upload for expirable types with expiration_date

Frontend docStatus() function correctly maps verification_status to badge text and colors
Mismatch note displayed via data-testid='mismatch-note-{doc_id}' with verification_notes content
